# LZMA SDK 26.03

7z decoder sources by Igor Pavlov, from the official LZMA SDK:
https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.03/lzma2603.7z
https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html

The LZMA SDK is in the public domain. The C source files and required headers
are copied without modification. Only the decoder is built; no external
7-Zip installation or executable is required.
